tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Section bands, table stripes, image placeholders.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, sheets. In light it relies on `line` for its edge.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Brand blocks, hero bands, the primary button fill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, card borders, dividers. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders. Meets 3:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-subtle and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, helper text on any surface (7:1+).

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and placeholders only. Not for readable copy.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: ink-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and outline-button borders on surface-inverse (footer, CTA bands). 7:1+.

tokens.name: line-inverse
tokens.usage: Hairlines on surface-inverse. Decorative only.

tokens.name: logo-mark
tokens.usage: The logo disc. Black on light surfaces, white in dark mode. Logo only.

tokens.name: logo-on-mark
tokens.usage: The "se" letters cut into the logo disc. Always the opposite of logo-mark. Logo only.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Volt. The one signal colour: the main CTA, active states, brand moments. One accent CTA per view.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Always black (8:1); white fails (2.6:1).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Volt as text: links, active tab labels, on surface (5.4:1) or accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind accent-text: selected rows, promo badges.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: In stock, online, charging, completed. Text on surface or success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background for success badges and banners.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Low stock, low battery, maintenance due. Text on surface or warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background for warning badges and banners.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, faults, out of stock, offline. Text on surface or danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background for danger badges, banners and invalid inputs.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices and tips. Text on surface or info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background for info badges and banners.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus outline, offset 2px. Solid ink so it shows on every surface, accent fills included.

tokens.name: viz-solar
tokens.usage: Charts: solar generation (sun yellow, kept apart from the brand green).

tokens.name: viz-battery
tokens.usage: Charts: battery charge and discharge.

tokens.name: viz-grid
tokens.usage: Charts: grid import and baseline series.

tokens.name: viz-fuel
tokens.usage: Charts: fuel, gas and diesel volumes.

styles.name: display-2xl
styles.usage: Hero headline on marketing pages. One per page.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline on tablet; section openers on desktop.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Hero headline on mobile; big campaign statements.

styles.name: heading-5
styles.usage: Small card titles, list group headers.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default running text. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Dense UI text, table cells, helper text.

styles.name: label-lg
styles.usage: Large buttons and prominent form labels.

styles.name: numeric-xl
styles.usage: Hero metrics: kWh, battery %, savings. Tabular figures.

styles.name: numeric-lg
styles.usage: Stat tile values and prices on product pages. Tabular figures.

styles.name: numeric
styles.usage: Prices on cards, table numbers, quantities. Tabular figures.

spacing.note: Doubles (2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128) are the backbone; half-steps (12, 24, 48, 96) fill the gaps.

tokens.name: space-0
tokens.usage: No gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Hairline nudges: icon-to-text optical fixes.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tightest gap: badge padding, icon and label inside a chip.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Default inline gap: icon to label in buttons, items in a row of chips.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Half-step. Gap between label and input; small card padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Base unit. Mobile page gutter, card padding, stacked form fields.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Half-step. Desktop card padding, gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Gap between content groups inside a section; desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Half-step. Space between sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Space between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-96
tokens.usage: Half-step. Hero padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-128
tokens.usage: Largest break: marketing page openers and closers.

size.note: Control heights and icon sizes, on the same 2s scale.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, compact inputs, table row actions.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button and input height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary mobile CTAs and hero buttons. Meets the 44px touch target.

tokens.name: icon-16
tokens.usage: Icons inside small buttons, badges and captions.

tokens.name: icon-20
tokens.usage: Icons inside default buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: icon-24
tokens.usage: Standalone icons, navigation, list items.

tokens.name: icon-32
tokens.usage: Feature icons on service cards.

tokens.name: icon-48
tokens.usage: Empty states and large feature callouts.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Full-bleed images, tables, hero bands.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, tooltips, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, images inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-16
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs, panels.

tokens.name: radius-24
tokens.usage: Large feature panels and mobile bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, icon buttons, avatars. Echoes the circular logo.

tokens.name: border-1
tokens.usage: Default borders and dividers.

tokens.name: border-2
tokens.usage: Selected cards, focus rings, emphasis.

breakpoint.note: Every breakpoint is a multiple of 128.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones and up: 4 → 8 columns.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablets: 8 columns, 24px gutters.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Laptops: 12 columns, 32px gutters.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Desktop: 12 columns, content max 1216px.

tokens.name: bp-2xl
tokens.usage: Wide screens: content stays at max width, margins grow.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Resting cards in dense UIs; inputs on subtle surfaces.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, dropdown menus, popovers.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, bottom sheets, cart drawer.

duration.note: Motion durations. UI stays at 320ms or under; 480ms is for rare marketing moments.

tokens.name: duration-0
tokens.usage: Keyboard-triggered actions and repeat tooltips. Frequent actions get no animation.

tokens.name: duration-120
tokens.usage: Hover colour and border changes, chip selection, focus rings.

tokens.name: duration-160
tokens.usage: Press feedback (scale 0.97), switch thumb, checkbox tick, tooltips.

tokens.name: duration-240
tokens.usage: Dropdowns, selects, accordion, segmented-control indicator, toasts.

tokens.name: duration-320
tokens.usage: Modals, drawers, mobile bottom sheets, cart drawer. The longest UI duration.

tokens.name: duration-480
tokens.usage: Expressive only: hero entrance, chart bars growing, the request-sent check. Once per visit.

easing.note: Never ease-in on UI: it delays the moment people are watching.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default. Anything entering, exiting or responding to a press. Starts fast, so the UI feels instant.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Things moving or morphing on screen: switch thumb, segmented indicator, carousel.

tokens.name: ease-drawer
tokens.usage: Drawers and bottom sheets (iOS-like).

tokens.name: ease-hover
tokens.usage: Hover colour, border and shadow changes (the CSS ease curve).

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: Constant motion only: progress bars, spinners.

interaction.note: Scale, offset and stagger values used with the duration and easing tokens.

tokens.name: motion-press-scale
tokens.usage: Scale on press for every pressable element. Never below 0.95.

tokens.name: motion-enter-scale
tokens.usage: Starting scale for popovers and modals entering. Never scale(0).

tokens.name: motion-enter-offset
tokens.usage: Starting translateY for content fading in (hero lines, toasts, cards).

tokens.name: motion-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between items in a staggered group. Decorative: never blocks input.
